title: Quick and easy purification of murine untouched naive B cells or germinal center B cells by MACS
protocol: Harvest the spleen from mice euthanized according to institutional guidelines.
Sterilize all equipment with 70% ethanol or by autoclave before use in a laminar flow hood.
Lay the mouse on its side with the left side up on a paper towel.
Spray the mouse with 70% ethanol for easier incision.
Cut away skin and open the body cavity around the midline of the mouse.
Carefully lift the spleen up using dissecting forceps.
Cut the vessels and other attachments at the hilum of the spleen with dissecting scissors.
Place the isolated spleen in a 15-mL conical tube filled with 4 mL PBS on ice.
Pour the collected spleen and PBS into a 60-mm cell culture dish.
Dissociate the spleen mechanically using gentle force between rough ends of frosted microscope slides.
Work through smaller segments of the spleen, dipping slide ends in PBS to flush off cells before moving to the next segment.
Pipette carefully (with a P1000) the homogenized cell solution (∼4 mL) back into the 15-mL conical tube.
Layer the conical tube with a precut 70 μm Nylon mesh to filter the solution.
Rinse remaining cells in the dish with 1–2 mL cold PBS and pipette through the Nylon mesh into the conical tube.
Spin down the conical tube at 400 × g for 3 min at 4°C to pellet the homogenized cells.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 3 mL ACK buffer for 3 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C) to lyse red blood cells.
Add 7 mL cold PBS to dilute ACK buffer and quench lysis.
Spin down the conical tube at 400 × g for 3 min at 4°C to pellet the white blood cells.
Ensure red blood cells have been efficiently removed from the pellet, which should appear white.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend white blood cells in 10 mL cold PBS.
Determine the total cell number by a hemocytometer or an automated cell counter.
Save a small aliquot of the cell solution for flow cytometry pre-purification analysis (for step 31) of B cells and/or GC B cells on ice.
Spin down the conical tube at 400 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant from the enumerated white blood cell pellet.
Resuspend 1 × 10^7 cells in 100 μL MACS buffer.
Add 10 μL anti-CD43 MicroBeads per 1 × 10^7 cells.
Adjust to the total cell number by adding 45 μL anti-CD43 MicroBeads to 45 × 10^6 cells.
Gently shake or flick the tube.
Label cells for 10–15 min on ice.
Add 1 mL MACS buffer for each 1 × 10^7 cells and spin at 400 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Place LS column in the magnet and equilibrate with 3 mL MACS buffer.
Ensure buffer has completely passed through the column.
Place a new uncapped 15-mL conical tube under the column.
Resuspend the anti-CD43 MicroBeads-labeled cell pellet in 500 μL MACS buffer (for up to 1 × 10^8 cells) and load onto the equilibrated column.
Once cells have passed through the column reservoir, add 6 mL of MACS buffer.
Once this buffer has passed through, add an additional 3 mL of MACS buffer.
Mix unlabeled B cells in a 15-mL conical tube.
Determine the number of naive B cells if purification is from unimmunized mice.
Wash naive B cells if they are to be used immediately after determination.
Resuspend 1 × 10^7 purified B cells in 100 μL MACS buffer.
Add diluted anti-CD38-biotin (4 μL per 1 × 10^7 cells) to the resuspended cells.
Add diluted anti-CD11c-biotin (2 μL per 1 × 10^7 cells) to the resuspended cells.
Label cells for 10–15 minutes on ice.
Add 1 mL MACS buffer per 1 × 10^7 cells and spin at 400 × g for 3 minutes at 4°C.
Remove supernatant after spinning the tube.
Resuspend each 1 × 10^7 cells in 100 μL MACS buffer.
Add 20 μL of anti-biotin MicroBeads per 1 × 10^7 cells to the resuspended cells.
Label cells for 10 minutes on ice.
Add 1 mL MACS buffer for each 1 × 10^7 cells.
Spin the tube at 400 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Place a new LS column in the magnet and equilibrate with 3 mL MACS buffer.
Remove supernatant from the anti-biotin MicroBeads-labeled cell pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in 500 μL MACS buffer.
Load the resuspended cells onto the newly equilibrated column.
Once the buffer has completely passed through the column, place a screwcap onto the 15-mL conical tube containing the purified GC B cells.
Spin the tube at 400 × g for 3–5 min at 4°C.
Remove supernatant leaving approximately 50 μL to avoid disturbing the pellet.
Resuspend the GC B cell pellet in 1 mL cold PBS.
Transfer the GC B cell suspension into a prechilled 1.5-mL Microcentrifuge tube.
Determine the cell number of GC B cells.
Save a small aliquot for flow cytometry post-purification analysis on ice.
Transfer aliquots of total splenocytes, purified B cells, and/or GC B cells to 1.5-mL Mini tubes or 5-mL Round bottom tubes.
Add 1 mL of Staining buffer to the sample tubes.
Spin at 400 × g for 3–5 minutes at 4°C.
While spinning, make an antibody staining master mix for 50 μL per stain with anti-CD16/CD32 Fc Block.
Mix in 0.5 μL (0.25 μg) of anti-B220-APC-eFluor780 into the antibody staining master mix.
Add 0.1 μL (0.05 μg) of anti-GL7-FITC to the antibody staining master mix.
Mix in 0.5 μL (0.1 μg) of anti-FAS-PE-Cy7 into the antibody staining master mix.
Carefully aspirate the supernatant from sample tubes.
Scratch the 1.1-mL Mini tubes over the rack to disturb the pellet.
Add approximately 50 μl of the staining solution made in step 33 to each sample tube.
Vortex quickly.
Incubate cells for 15 min on ice in the dark.
Make single compensation controls using Compensation Beads with unstained, anti-B220-APC-eFluor780, anti-GL7-FITC and anti-FAS-PE-Cy7 combinations.
Add one small drop of Compensation Beads into 1.1-mL tubes.
Add approximately 1 μl of indicated antibodies to each compensation control tube.
Stain for 5–10 min in the dark.
Wash cells once with 1 ml staining buffer after completing cell staining.
Add 1 mL Staining buffer and spin cells at 400 × g for 3–5 min at 4°C.
Carefully aspirate supernatant of tubes and resuspend in Staining buffer corresponding to the cell number (∼500 μL for 1 × 10^6 cells; add 50 μL to the compensation controls).
Place 1.1-mL Mini tubes in a 5-mL Round bottom tube for sealing and placement in position for the Sample Injection Port (SIP) of the flow cytometer.
Remove 1.1-mL Mini tube between samples from the 5-mL Round bottom tube.
Resuspend stained cell sample in 100 μL Staining buffer and add 5 μL 7-AAD.
Incubate cells 5–10 min on ice in the dark.
Add ∼400 μL Staining buffer after incubation.
